summary: Phase 6 P0 features tested end-to-end: (1) Emergency Booking Priority backend (6 endpoints), (2) Aircraft Comparison modal, (3) Multi-City Route Builder + Map. Backend: 14/14 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_emergency_booking.py — /api/emergency/config returns correct URGENCY_LEVELS+URGENCY_REASONS, POST /create requires auth, rejects invalid urgency_level, computes priority_score correctly (critical(1)-medical(1)=0, medium(3)-vip(0)=3), sets surcharge_percent (50/25/10), operators_notified count, and emergency_number 'EMR…' — persisted and returned by /my-requests. RBAC verified: /operator/pending returns 403 for customer, 200 for operator; /queue returns 403 for customer & operator, 200 for admin with results priority-sorted ascending; /respond returns 403 for customer, 404 for unknown id, 200 for operator and records response in DB. Frontend (public URL, /booking): Step 2 (Booking Type) shows Emergency Booking button (data-testid=emergency-booking-btn) and Compare Aircraft button (data-testid=compare-aircraft-btn); all 9 booking-type cards render (One Way, Round Trip, Multi-City, Hourly Charter, Daily Charter, Multi-Day, 5+ pax [group], Emergency, Event). Emergency modal opens with 3 urgency levels + 5 reasons + Pickup/Drop/Flight-Details form. Compare modal opens listing seeded verified aircraft (H145, 407, Citation XLS) with '0/3 selected' counter. Multi-City card selection routes Step 3 to MultiCityRouteBuilder which renders Leg 1 (Start), Leg 2 (End 5% off), 'Add Destination (2/8)' auto-chaining note, waiting-time and night-halts options.

minor.issue: When no operators are within radius, status is set to 'no_operators_found' — but the request STILL returns success:true with operators_notified=0 and no user-facing hint of retry/fallback. Consider surfacing a distinct message so the customer knows the broadcast reached zero operators.

Once an emergency has status='no_operators_found' operators can no longer respond (400 'no longer accepting responses'). If a late operator becomes available (comes online/gets verified) they cannot help. Consider re-opening or manual admin re-broadcast.
Priority sort is (priority_score asc, created_at asc) but response also carries the full priority_levels config on every call — slightly wasteful; move to /config only.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal (fixed inset-0 z-50 overlay) does NOT close on Escape key press. Only the X icon in the header dismisses it. Screenshot confirms — after Escape the overlay still intercepts pointer events and blocks the underlying Next button. Add onKeyDown listener or migrate to shadcn Dialog primitive.

Same — clicking outside the modal or pressing Escape does not close the Emergency Booking modal. Only a manual Cancel/close control works. Add backdrop-click and Escape handlers for accessibility and to prevent scroll-lock.

Step 3 (multi-city) uses the browser's native mm/dd/yyyy and --:-- pickers instead of shadcn Calendar+Time components used elsewhere in the app. Inconsistent UX and no locale support for Indian date format.

Card labels are visually truncated to 'Mult…', 'Roun…', 'Daily…', 'Hour…' etc. on 1920px viewport because of narrow fixed-width tiles. Full names are only visible on hover/selection. Consider two-row wrap or tooltip.

MultiCityRouteMap only renders when 'showMap && totalDistance > 0'. With empty legs the map is hidden — could not be visually confirmed in this test run without filling from/to landing points (which require /api/landing-points lookups). Recommend a placeholder map (India centroid) or a note when legs are empty so users know the map exists.

issues: Emergency Booking button has red outline + red text — good contrast on dark bg
'Please login to submit booking inquiry' banner appears at bottom of every step for anonymous visitors — expected

action_items: Make AircraftCompareModal + EmergencyBookingForm modals dismiss on Escape and on backdrop click (currently only the X button works — trap-focus without keyboard exit is an a11y/UX bug).

Emergency /create: return a distinct status/message ('no_operators_found') to the frontend so the UI can prompt the user to widen radius, escalate urgency, or contact admin directly. Currently returns success:true with operators_notified=0.
Consider allowing admin re-broadcast of a 'no_operators_found' emergency once new operators come online, rather than terminally blocking responses.
Replace native date/time inputs in MultiCityRouteBuilder with the shadcn Calendar/TimePicker components already used elsewhere.
Show a placeholder Leaflet map (or an empty India-centered map) inside MultiCityRouteBuilder even before any leg coordinates are set, so users can discover the map feature.
critical_code_review_comments: emergency_booking_routes.py:find_available_operators — when operator.base_latitude is missing it falls back to `emergency.from_latitude`, meaning that operator is treated as if co-located at the emergency origin (distance=0 km) and is always inside the radius. That means an operator with a missing base location is always notified. This is generous by design but should be documented — otherwise a genuine 800km-away operator with a null base_lat looks like a 0km match.

emergency_booking_routes.py:respond_to_emergency — validates aircraft only when can_fulfill and aircraft_id are both truthy. Operators can respond can_fulfill=True with no aircraft_id — this saves a 'yes' with no aircraft attached and confuses downstream select-operator. Add: `if response.can_fulfill and not response.aircraft_id: raise HTTPException(400, 'aircraft_id required when can_fulfill=True')`.

emergency_booking_routes.py:select_emergency_operator — uses Depends(get_current_user) but does not enforce role or that the current_user is the customer. It correctly checks `emergency.customer_id != current_user.id` so unauthorized selection is blocked. OK, but consider adding an explicit customer/admin role guard for defence-in-depth.

MultiCityRouteBuilder line 188: `showMap && totalDistance > 0` — this hides the map until at least one leg has geocoded coords. As a P0 'Multi-City Map View' feature this makes the map invisible to users who haven't yet picked landing points; consider always rendering an India-centered placeholder map and updating it live as legs are added.

AircraftCompareModal (raw fixed inset-0 overlay, not @radix Dialog) — lacks Escape-to-close, backdrop-click-to-close, focus trap, and aria-labelling. Prefer migrating to the existing shadcn `<Dialog>` primitive used elsewhere for consistency and a11y.

BookingPage.js is 2146 lines (was already flagged in earlier iterations). Split render*Step functions into their own files; adding Emergency/Compare/MultiCity has pushed this deeper into monolith territory.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — Emergency + Compare + 9 booking types + MultiCity route builder all render correctly; Leaflet map render deferred to legs-with-coords which was not visually confirmed; modals lack Escape/backdrop close

context_for_next_testing_agent: Emergency backend is fully functional (14/14). Frontend integration: Emergency + Compare buttons live on Step 2 with correct testids, 9 booking types render, MultiCity switches Step 3 to the route-builder tree. The Leaflet map inside MultiCityRouteBuilder only renders once legs have valid from/to coordinates — the placeholder-empty case was tested and the map is intentionally hidden. To visually confirm the Leaflet rendering, fill Leg1.from and Leg1.to via /api/landing-points/search results (LandingPointSelector) and re-open Step 3. Also verify the /respond → /select-operator → /notifications flow end-to-end with a live operator response (only 'cannot fulfill' path was exercised here). Modal Escape/backdrop-close is a known UX gap for both AircraftCompareModal and EmergencyBookingForm.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking defects. Two minor findings: (a) modals lack Escape/backdrop dismiss (AircraftCompareModal, EmergencyBookingForm), root cause is that both are hand-rolled `fixed inset-0` overlays rather than shadcn Dialog primitives — migrating to Dialog resolves it; (b) MultiCity Leaflet map hides when totalDistance==0, root cause is the explicit render guard `showMap && totalDistance > 0` — dropping the totalDistance>0 half (or defaulting to an India-centered empty map) makes the P0 map discoverable immediately.
